canonical_orientation.rule: For each primitive PL vector, the first nonzero coordinate is positive; orient the associated thimble compatibly.

selected_central_lifts.selection_source: interval leading-coefficient winding, not period fitting

theorem.name: Q79SelectedAlignmentCoupledIntegralPrimaryH2BasisTheorem
theorem.statement: With the interval-selected central lifts +A and -B and canonically oriented selected thimbles, the 98-chain boundary kernel has rank 94. The four coupled thimble/Fox surface relations form a primitive sublattice with Smith diagonal (1,1,1,1); the emitted quotient basis is therefore a torsion-free rank-90 primary integral H2 basis.
